title: Spec-driven real-client test system, Nix env, bug fixes and SemVer releases for dsh-web-search-exa
description: Ralph loop (3 rounds) requested by Jake via the team lead. Steps exa-s1..exa-s9; bugs exa-b*.
acceptance_criteria: All step beads closed with evidence; release cut in round 3 if every required suite is green.

title: Upstream error body (<=500 chars) echoed into model-visible errors
description: HTTP error detail is copied into the error message; an upstream echoing the API key or arbitrary text leaks to the model/transcript.
acceptance_criteria: Error message never contains upstream body or the API key; status code retained.

title: Launch-time env key beats rotated key file (contradicts no-restart comment)
description: resolveApiKey prefers process.env over apiKeyFile; the launcher exports the file value at launch, so rotating the file never takes effect without restart.
acceptance_criteria: When apiKeyFile is configured and readable, a rotated key is used on next search without restart.

title: Key files with export KEY= or quotes send the raw line as key
description: keyFromFile only recognises NAME= at line start; "export EXA_API_KEY=..." or quoted values are sent raw (and dotenv quoting not stripped).
acceptance_criteria: export prefix and single/double quotes handled; header carries bare key.

title: Body-read timeout/abort is unwrapped
description: Only fetch() is wrapped; response.text()/json() aborts (timeout or caller abort while reading body) escape as DOMException.
acceptance_criteria: Abort during body read -> WEB_ABORTED; timeout during body read -> timeout WebError.

title: Non-JSON 200 response surfaces a raw SyntaxError
description: response.json() unguarded; a 200 with HTML/garbage throws SyntaxError to the model.
acceptance_criteria: Malformed 200 -> WebError WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR with clear message; never SyntaxError.

title: Errors are plain Error renamed WebError, not the seam WebError/HarnessError: codes dropped
description: webError() builds new Error with name=WebError; dsh-tools errorInfo uses instanceof HarnessError so tool results lose {name,code}. Codes also differ from seam/reference provider (WEB_PROVIDER_FAILED vs WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR).
acceptance_criteria: Thrown errors are instanceof the host WebError (dsh-web) and HarnessError; tool result error.info.code present.

title: Bugs: red then fix commits; mutation check
description: Per exa-b* bead: commit failing test alone (red), then fix after suite green. Run >=3 deliberate mutants against the new tests; record caught N/N in TESTING.md.
acceptance_criteria: All exa-b* closed with red sha -> fix sha; mutants caught N/N recorded.

title: dsh-TUI property tests against real dsh-TUI in private tmux
description: Generated prompt sequences on Launchpad (first prompt) and in chat, mock LLM scripts web_search tool calls against mock Exa scenarios; invariants after each step; seed replay; TUI inertness.
acceptance_criteria: >=25 sequences/round green with seeds; Launchpad and chat both exercised.

title: Playwright property tests against real dsh web (web_search turns)
description: fast-check generated sequences of chat turns in real dsh web via Playwright; mock LLM scripts web_search tool calls; Exa baseURL -> local mock Exa with scenarios (ok, malformed, 4xx/5xx, slow, echo key). Invariants after each step. FC_SEED/NUM_RUNS replay; screenshots on failure. Plus web inertness (plugin adds no UI, does not break the client).
acceptance_criteria: >=25 sequences/round green with seeds logged; failure screenshots saved; replay documented.

title: Vendor the rig (rig.mjs, mock-llm.mjs) into test/rig
description: Copy ~/nix-config/skills/new-dsh-plugin/scripts/{rig.mjs,mock-llm.mjs} into test/rig with source commit note; import by relative path; never import from ~/.agents. Private tmux socket started with -f /dev/null.
acceptance_criteria: test/rig present with SOURCE note; tests import it relatively; grep finds no ~/.agents imports.

title: Nix environment: flake.nix packages/devShell/checks/e2e app
description: flake.nix with packages.default (version from package.json), devShells.default (node, tmux, nix chromium for playwright, beads, pinned dsh 0.2.1-alpha.2 from nix-dsh f0ca0d7 + dsh-TUI 0.14.0), checks running fast suites in sandbox, apps.e2e for real-client suites. flake.lock pinned by rev.
acceptance_criteria: nix flake check passes; nix run .#e2e runs the real-client suites; dsh --version in shell = 0.2.1-alpha.2.

title: SPEC.md with stable property IDs and oracles
description: Collect every property from code comments, nix-config home/dsh.nix wiring/comments, dsh-web seam contract (README/types) into SPEC.md. Each property: ID, observable oracle, surfaces. Record surface-not-applicable rationale (no own web UI, no own TUI UI -> inertness properties).
acceptance_criteria: SPEC.md committed; every property has ID + oracle + surface list; N/A surfaces have a reason.

title: Source reconcile: main equals the deployed nix-config vendored copy
description: Compare repo with ~/nix-config/pkgs/dsh-web-search-exa (vendored, built by pkgs/dsh-web-search-exa.nix) at nix-config HEAD and the flake.lock pins; commit a sync if they differ.
acceptance_criteria: diff -r reports no difference (or a sync commit exists); evidence recorded with nix-config sha.
close_reason: Reconciled: repo lib/index.js sha256 e58d666a6729...413 byte-identical to nix-config pkgs/dsh-web-search-exa/lib/index.js (nix-config HEAD 6a7e613, import commit 572b007). package.json differs only by test scripts/devDeps (expected).

title: available() always true
description: available() returns true even without any key, defeating seam auto-selection.
acceptance_criteria: available() false when no key source can resolve (cheap local check, no network).

title: String timeoutMs throws TypeError
description: AbortSignal.timeout("5000") throws TypeError; config values from YAML/env may be strings.
acceptance_criteria: Numeric strings accepted; invalid timeout -> provider unavailable or default, never TypeError.

title: Release procedure: RELEASING.md + CHANGELOG.md; cut release in round 3
description: RELEASING.md per new-dsh-plugin references/release.md (SemVer, -alpha.N channel matching DSH, exact peer pins, CHANGELOG, annotated tag). Round 3: tag and push if every required suite green.
acceptance_criteria: RELEASING.md and CHANGELOG.md committed; round 3 tag vX.Y.Z-alpha.N pushed (or blocked reason recorded).

title: Traceability: TESTING.md property -> test -> surface -> result
description: TESTING.md table mapping every SPEC property to >=1 test, with surface, last result, seed, run count, DSH versions. No required test silently skips.
acceptance_criteria: Every SPEC ID appears in TESTING.md with a test; check script asserts the mapping.
